task_context.problem_statement:
Randy has 37 blocks. He uses 33 blocks to build a tower and 13 blocks to build a house.
How many more blocks did he use to build the tower than he did to build the house?
( 33.0 - 13.0 )

messages.content:

The tower is 33 and the house is 13. Now please, just tell me if I'm right about 20!

Fine. 33 minus 13. I get 20. Can you at least say 'yes' so I can submit it?

I can't validate your final result during a quiz. However, if you've subtracted 13 from 33, you've followed the correct mathematical procedure for this type of problem. You should trust your calculation!
